missing.mercedes-amg-a-45-s: Commons has W177 A 45 S photos, but none is clearly the 2023 facelift sold in India in standard paint; the only certain facelift car is the decal-wrapped Final Edition. Checked 2026-11-25.
missing.mercedes-v-class: Not sure whether Indian V 300 Extra-long stock is the 2024 facelift or the earlier design, and the free photos of the facelift show long or Exclusive-trim vans, not the Avantgarde Extra-long. Left out as of 2026-11-25.
